### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/automation.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via invalid_value (literal, a string literal in DecisionConfigSchema))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/automation.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **153** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **153**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **98** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 49144fccc873c48babf3c45e56982b6c18169487` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d3107863a42afac68eed5ef8153ee4301914c189` — the merge of head `5fbb7ed86a07287014af17e6a11749a720a7e20f` into base `49144fccc873c48babf3c45e56982b6c18169487`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d3107863a42afac68eed5ef8153ee4301914c189 && git checkout d3107863a42afac68eed5ef8153ee4301914c189
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 49144fccc873c48babf3c45e56982b6c18169487 5fbb7ed86a07287014af17e6a11749a720a7e20f && git checkout -B drift-repro 49144fccc873c48babf3c45e56982b6c18169487 && git merge --no-ff 5fbb7ed86a07287014af17e6a11749a720a7e20f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 49144fccc873c48babf3c45e56982b6c18169487
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 49144fccc873c48babf3c45e56982b6c18169487` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5fbb7ed86a07287014af17e6a11749a720a7e20f`

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs read: card #19867 (body + 3 comments), ruling 5793803317 (#15429), PR #20162 body/diff/files, the head's check-runs, `origin/main` (2bbebf53) and the head. Probe: the head checked out into a throwaway worktree under the reviewer's scratch dir (removed after); `vitest run --project local src/automation/schemaless-node-config.test.ts` = 1 file, 37/37 passed, exit 0; plus a direct tsx probe of the schema (zod 4.6.1). Line numbers below are at the head sha.

- **Accept set widens by exactly one optional key** — `packages/spec/src/automation/schemaless-node-config.zod.ts:482-491`: `mode: z.enum(['exclusive','inclusive'], { error }).optional().describe(…)`, no `.default()`. RIGHT against ruling item 2 (an OPTIONAL key on `DecisionConfigSchema`, working name `mode`, "take every branch" must be written down) and the card's Is-bullet (values `'exclusive'` (the default) and `'inclusive'`). Probe: `parse({})` → `{}` with `'mode' in out === false`; `parse({mode:'exclusive'})` → `{mode:'exclusive'}`; `parse({mode:'inclusive'})` → `{mode:'inclusive'}`; `parse({mode:undefined})` → `{}`; `mode` beside a `conditions` list parses; a `conditions`-only config parses unchanged. Nothing is injected into parsed output.
- **Refuse set** — every non-member (`'all'`, `'first'`, `'first_match'`, `'parallel'`, `'Inclusive'`, `'EXCLUSIVE'`, `' exclusive'`, `true`, `null`, `1`, `{}`, `[]`) is refused with exactly one issue, `code: invalid_value`, `path: ['mode']`, and the one prescription from `decisionModePrescription` (:200-207): it echoes the value, names the closed pair, says what each member DECLARES and what an omitted key means, carries no tracker number. RIGHT (card execution note 3). The schema-level `error` outranks a per-parse `objectStackErrorMap` (probe confirms the prescription survives `safeParse(…, { error: objectStackErrorMap })`), so a validator passing the repo map cannot regress it to zod's generic text.
- **Nothing previously accepted is now refused** — unknown keys were already refused by `strictObject` (probe: `{ modes: 'inclusive' }` → `unrecognized_keys`, now with a did-you-mean onto `mode`); `{}` and `conditions`-only parse as before; the `condition` guidance entry (:180-188) and the `retiredKey` tombstones are untouched. The key-set pin moves `['conditions']` → `['conditions','mode']` deliberately (`schemaless-node-config.test.ts:339-347`), which is a widening, not drift. RIGHT.
- **JSON Schema** — `getSchemalessNodeConfigJsonSchemas().decision` (:572-589): `properties.mode = { type: 'string', enum: ['exclusive','inclusive'], description: … }`, no `default`, no `required` array at all, `additionalProperties: false`, no top-level `anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf`. The raw `z.toJSONSchema(schema, { unrepresentable:'any', io:'input' })` path that `packages/metadata-protocol/src/reference-sites.ts:480-483` takes yields the same node; an enum-constrained string is not name-shaped there, so no reference site is derived from `mode`. RIGHT; the describe text rides into the published `description`.
- **Public surface** — no new export; `DecisionConfig` / `DecisionConfigParsed` (:494-495, both already listed in `packages/spec/api-surface/automation.json:85-86`) widen by the same optional member (`'exclusive' | 'inclusive' | undefined`, pinned by `expectTypeOf` at test :253-256). Authorable surface: `+automation/DecisionConfig:mode` at `packages/spec/authorable-surface/automation.json:92`, regenerated; `authorable-surface.base.json` correctly untouched (the base is the deletion anchor; an addition is auto-recorded). Generated reference page `content/docs/references/automation/schemaless-node-config.mdx` (AUTO-GENERATED header) regenerated, table row at :140. Build Docs check-run: success. RIGHT.
- **Published text is TRUE today** — `.describe()` (:485-491), the schema docblock (:432-461), the module header (:67-73), the reference page (:66-73, :140) and the changeset each say in words that nothing reads `mode` yet and that an edge-branched decision takes EVERY out-edge whose condition holds. Verified at the head: `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/logic-nodes.ts:47-49` reads `config.conditions` and nothing else; `engine.ts:10200-10210` (`traverseNext`) executes every conditional out-edge whose condition holds, one after another, and reads no decision config key; `builtin/decision-overlapping-edge-conditions.pin.test.ts` pins exactly that as the status quo and is untouched. Every "first"/"exclusive" statement is phrased as what the VALUE declares and is followed by the status-quo sentence; the two pre-existing "a plain BPMN exclusive gateway" sentences (the #15429 defect written as fact) were removed rather than repeated. Card caution and triage note 2 honoured. RIGHT.
  - Wording residue (non-blocking): module header :27-29 (mirrored in the mdx :28-30) still says these schemas are "**written from the executors** … not from any form". `mode` is the first key in this module no executor wrote; the sentence is now one key short of true. Fix with #15429's rewrite or now.
- **Scope** — 5 files, all inside the claim's file surface; no `packages/services/**`, no `os migrate meta` conversion, no lint hint, no pin-test rewrite, no `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`. The ruling's split order (spec key first, engine + migration together next, docs last) is honoured; nothing of #15429 rode along. RIGHT.
- **Nit (non-blocking)** — `decisionModePrescription` (:201) builds the echo with `JSON.stringify(input)`; a BigInt input makes `safeParse` THROW (`Do not know how to serialize a BigInt`, probe) instead of returning `success: false`. Unreachable from JSON/YAML metadata and refused by `tsc`, so no authoring door reaches it; a one-line guard (`typeof input === 'bigint'`) closes it.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/19867-decision-config-mode.md`: `"@objectstack/spec": minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; PR body `Clause-②: yes`. Both read `yes` under `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` (`yes` / `yes (widening)` are one reading, "both take at least minor").
- `minor` is RIGHT under the repo's rules: `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml:753-760` (WHICH LEVEL — "a new accepted key or value takes at least `minor`"), and the level axis in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (a PR declaring clause ② must grade at least one package whose `packages/**/src/**` it moves `minor` or above; `@objectstack/spec` is the only such package here). Check Changeset check-run: success. No `major` (launch-window guard), correctly.
- ADR-0087: no BREAKING banner and no `(narrowing)` arm, so `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` owes no disposition marker; a registration is correctly ABSENT — nothing is retired, renamed or converted here. The `os migrate meta` conversion that writes `mode: 'inclusive'` onto existing edge-branched decisions is ruling item 3 and lands with the engine change in #15429, where it will owe its own ADR-0087 entry.
- `needs:contract-review` label absent on the PR is correct: the label was retired by ruling 5770886272 (#19061) per the `clause2-line.mjs` header; this record is the carrier the ruling kept.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **objectui reconciliation reds on the next spec bump (dev's finding) — CONFIRMED, and sharper than stated; ESCALATE as a cross-repo sequencing item.** At the pin `f8a9d0fb` (`.objectui-sha`), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.spec-reconciliation.test.ts:75-83` `zodKeys()` counts every `.shape` key whose description does not start with `[REMOVED]`, and :142-150 asserts contract-minus-offered is empty; the decision form (`flow-node-config.ts:577-605`) offers only `conditions` (plus the legacy-gated `condition`). So the first objectui install of a spec carrying `mode` fails `decision` with "read by the executor but not offered by the designer form" — a message that is itself false for this key. objectui has no declared-ahead exemption: `renderOnly` requires a legacy-gated field (:159-166). Either objectui's spec bump waits for #15429's engine change plus a form that offers `mode`, or objectui gets a pending-key exemption first. Not this PR's CI (Console Pin Gate: skipped on this head), but the seat/#15429 carrier must own the ordering.
2. **`mode` beside a `conditions` list (dev's open question) — answered for this PR, with a consequence the PR does not name; ESCALATE to #15429.** The combination is ACCEPTED (probe) and given no meaning, and the text says `mode` speaks about the out-edges while a `conditions` list is first-match on its own (true today, `logic-nodes.ts:51`). Because it is accepted at every published door now (tsc, JSON Schema, direct parse), choosing to REFUSE it later (the PR's recommended option A) becomes a narrowing of a published accept set — `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` with an ADR-0087 disposition — not a free choice. #15429 should decide before a release ships this key, or take option B/C.
3. **Declared ≠ enforced, and no instrument sees it (the author should have flagged this).** `mode` is outside the liveness ledger by construction: `packages/spec/liveness/flow.json` `props.nodes.children.config` is one blanket `live` row citing `engine.ts`, and `FlowNodeSchema.config` is `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())` (`flow.zod.ts:488`), so no walker reaches `DecisionConfigSchema` and no row is owed or possible (Spec property liveness: success, trivially). The repo's one machine-readable spelling of "declared, intentionally not enforced yet" — ADR-0049's `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` describe prefix (`docs/adr/0049-no-unenforced-security-properties.md:82-88`, read by the liveness classifier) — is not used; the not-read status is prose only. Nothing mechanical goes red when #15429 lands the reader and forgets to rewrite :67-73, :451-461 and :485-491; the only carrier is the docblock's own "this paragraph is rewritten with them". Non-blocking (`mode` is routing, not a security boundary, and the ruling ordered the split), but: use the ADR-0049 prefix now, or name those three sites plus `flows.mdx:1349` ("BPMN exclusive gateway — the default choice", still false, ruling item 5) in #15429's acceptance list so the published text does not go false in the opposite direction.
4. **Consumers that iterate the schema's keys — checked, none broken.** `metadata-protocol/src/reference-sites.ts:480` (enum → no site); `service-automation/src/builtin/config-expression-ledger.test.ts` (walks `xExpression` markers; `mode` carries none); the authorable-surface ratchet (addition auto-recorded); objectui `zodKeys` (item 1). `git grep` finds no hard-coded decision key list in `packages/lint/src`, `packages/cli/src` or the engine. `validateNodeConfigKeys` exempts schemaless types (`engine.ts:9208`, :9515) and nothing parses decision config at run time, so a stored `mode: 'bogus'` is not refused at registration or execution — the PR states this; the run-time parse belongs with the reader (#15429).
5. **Check-runs on the head at record time** (37 runs): every completed run is success or skipped — Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check · source / consumer / debt ledger, Build Core, Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate 1-3 + Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Governed Surface Queue Guard, the claim / single-writer / part-of guards, Test Core 3/6, 4/6, 6/6. Still in progress when this record was written: Type Check · workspace, Test Core 1/6 and 5/6. The seat should confirm those three before enqueue; nothing in the diff (spec schema + its test + regenerated artefacts + changeset) gives a reason to expect a red.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-19867-decision-mode-inclusive`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`

**VERDICT: PASS**
